label: Faccioli et al. (2010)
units: SD in cm at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (Douglas chapter-2 anchor equation) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Faccioli et al. (2010)

site.anchor_note: Site coefficients aB/aC/aD confirm A as the reference class.

coefficients.needed: The published SPECTRAL subset table for the long-period displacement response. Anchor coefficients a1-a5, aB/aC/aD, aN/aR/aS, k1-k3 and sigma are now available.

implementation_notes: Long-period displacement response is the defining benchmark feature.
Do not interpolate across unpublished long-period coefficients.
parameters.internal_units_note: The anchor block states log_base 10 but gives NO units. Still to be read off the paper.

resolution_provenance.distance.min_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): rmin 0.2* km (rrup; rhypo for small events)
resolution_provenance.distance.max_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): rmax 200* km
resolution_provenance.distance.approximate: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): values starred
resolution_provenance.periods.t_min_s: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): Tmin 0.05 s
resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code G; OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/cauzzi_faccioli_2008.py FaccioliEtAl2010 inherits IMC.GEOMETRIC_MEAN
resolution_provenance.internal_units: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/cauzzi_faccioli_2008.py converts PGA 'from m/s**2 to g' and DRS via DRS*(2*pi/T)**2*1e-2 (i.e. DRS in cm). Independent check: the PGA anchor (a1=-1.18, a2=0.559, a3=-1.624, a4=0.018, a5=0.445) gives 10**0.12 = 1.3 at Mw 6, Rrup 10 km, rock -- plausible as 1.3 m/s2 (0.13 g), absurd as 1.3 cm/s2. Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.283 states 'DRS(T) is in cm/s2', which is dimensionally impossible for a displacement spectrum and is treated as a catalogue error.
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/cauzzi_faccioli_2008.py (FaccioliEtAl2010.COEFFS, 'table 1 page 7') coefficient table; period count and range (22 periods, 0.05-20 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked. Douglas section 4.182: coefficients given only for a subset of the periods analysed -- do not interpolate between them.

parameters.units_warning: Douglas (2011) section 2.283 labels the units 'cm/s2'. That is wrong for a displacement spectrum and, for the PGA anchor, off by a factor of 100. Units are per-IMT: PGA in m/s2, SD (DRS) in cm. Confirm against Faccioli et al. (2010) Table 1 before writing a coefficient file.
